name: CerebrA PET
description: Regions for PET made from CerebrA with pons: the caudate edited by hand (the left one mirrored), cortical regions grown 3 mm and the cingulate, insula, basal ganglia, thalamus, amygdala and hippocampus 2 mm into the white matter and the unlabelled brain. Use with 0 mm growth.
